name: age
description: Applicant current age in completed years at the time of application

name: citizenship
description: Citizenship/residency status (e.g. Indian national, NRI, PIO, foreign national)

name: employment_type
description: Primary employment category of the applicant

name: employer_category
type: enum (govt_psu, defence, listed_mnc, large_private, small_unlisted, not_applicable)
description: Category tier of current employing organization

name: net_monthly_income
description: Net take-home monthly salary credited directly to bank account

name: gross_monthly_income
description: Gross monthly salary before statutory and tax deductions

name: annual_income_itr
description: Latest annual taxable income declared in Income Tax Return

name: work_experience_total
description: Total cumulative work experience across all employers

name: months_in_current_job
description: Continuous service tenure with present employer

name: business_vintage
description: Years/months of operational business vintage (self-employed only)

name: city_tier
description: Derived demographic classification of applicant residence

name: cibil_score
type: int (-1 for no history, else 300 to 900)
description: TransUnion CIBIL or bureau credit score

name: existing_emi_total
description: Sum of all active loan EMIs currently serviced

name: recent_enquiries_6m
description: Number of hard credit inquiries logged in preceding 6 months

name: past_delays_flag
description: Indicator of 30+ DPD defaults or write-offs in the last 24 months

name: requested_amount
description: Principal personal loan amount requested by applicant

name: requested_tenure
description: Desired loan repayment tenure in months

name: existing_salary_bank
description: Name of the bank holding applicant primary salary account
